rates.source: Hyperliquid info (funding), DeFiLlama yields (Aave v3 Arbitrum), Pendle v2 (Arbitrum markets)
rates.verdict: Pendle sUSDai 2027-06-24 pays 9.08% fixed against 11.54% variable (-2.46 pts, $137,981 deep); Aave Lemur supplies 2.70%, borrows 3.74%; best basis carry BTC: funding 1.37% − Lemur 2.70% = -1.33 pts.

intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.092% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 1–900 s; OpalX has 0 open orders on Arbitrum right now. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 62 Heron pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (49,261 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 3 pairs priced on two or more venues, 3 apart after fees — best vivid-cobalt-tapir +1.991% with a $69,445 thin leg. Heron ≈ $1.180.

rwa.verdict: 3 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Manatee: 4 pools from $1.13204 to $1.1558 (+2.10%), deepest on solana at $1.14946. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.
